Planted bushes are no longer treated as chests. The flame altar counts their fruit toward crafting, so searching "hazelnut" lit up every Hazelnut bush in the base, and with many of them in view the game crashed.
Crafting stations (spinning wheel, kiln, tanning station and the like) are no longer listed as chests in a base that has planted bushes.
Through-wall chest outlines have a detail limit, so many outlines at once can no longer crash the game.
Reported bugs fixed: game crash right after searching "hazelnut" (reported by Lomack).
